initiatives.name: Mass Liberation Project
initiatives.description: Las Vegas-based group led by people affected by incarceration. Runs the Vegas Freedom Fund bail fund and offers organizer training, political education and a fellowship.

initiatives.name: Wild West Access Fund of Nevada
initiatives.description: Reno-based abortion fund founded in 2021. Gives financial help for abortion care to Nevadans, including those traveling out of state, and offers clinic referrals.

initiatives.name: Northern Nevada Harm Reduction Alliance
initiatives.description: Organization expanding harm reduction education, overdose prevention, drug trend surveillance and notification, soft tissue infection prevention, outreach, and linkage to services.
